description: This file defines the FrameTree class and related classes for managing browser frames, browsing contexts, web sockets, and worker debuggers in Firefox. It handles frame creation, navigation, event listening, and WebSocket/WebWorker interactions within a browser environment.

classes.name: FrameTree
classes.description: Manages the hierarchy of browser frames, browsing contexts, and associated events, WebSocket, and worker debugging in Firefox.

classes.name: IsolatedWorld
classes.description: Represents an isolated JavaScript execution context within a frame, including scripts to evaluate and bindings.

classes.name: Frame
classes.description: Represents a single browser frame, manages its execution contexts, WebSocket events, navigation, and bindings.

classes.name: Worker
classes.description: Represents a dedicated web worker debugger instance associated with a frame.

methods.name: workers
methods.description: Returns a list of active worker instances.

methods.name: runtime
methods.description: Returns the runtime environment associated with the frame tree.

methods.name: setInitScripts
methods.description: Sets scripts to evaluate on new document creation within isolated worlds.

methods.name: _ensureWorld
methods.description: Ensures an isolated execution context exists for a given world name.

methods.name: _frameForWorker
methods.description: Retrieves the frame associated with a worker debugger.

methods.name: _onDOMWindowCreated
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new DOM window, clearing global objects.

methods.name: setJavaScriptDisabled
methods.description: Enables or disables JavaScript execution in all frames.

methods.name: _onWorkerCreated
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new worker debugger instance.

methods.name: _onWorkerDestroyed
methods.description: Handles the destruction of a worker debugger instance.

methods.name: allFramesInBrowsingContextGroup
methods.description: Returns all frames within a browsing context group.

methods.name: isPageReady
methods.description: Checks if the page is marked as ready.

methods.name: forcePageReady
methods.description: Marks the page as ready and emits the corresponding event.

methods.name: addBinding
methods.description: Adds a JavaScript binding to all frames.

methods.name: frameForBrowsingContext
methods.description: Retrieves a frame for a given browsing context.

methods.name: frameForDocShell
methods.description: Retrieves a frame for a given docShell.

methods.name: frame
methods.description: Retrieves a frame by its ID.

methods.name: frames
methods.description: Returns all frames in the main frame hierarchy.

methods.name: mainFrame
methods.description: Returns the main frame.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources and removes event listeners.

methods.name: onWindowEvent
methods.description: Handles window events such as DOM element insertion and navigation.

methods.name: _frameNavigationCommitted
methods.description: Handles actions after a frame's navigation is committed.

methods.name: onStateChange
methods.description: Handles web progress state changes, such as navigation aborts.

methods.name: onLocationChange
methods.description: Handles location change events for frames.

methods.name: _onBrowsingContextAttached
methods.description: Handles attaching a browsing context to the frame tree.

methods.name: _onBrowsingContextDetached
methods.description: Handles detaching a browsing context from the frame tree.

methods.name: _createFrame
methods.description: Creates a new frame for a browsing context.

methods.name: _detachFrame
methods.description: Detaches and disposes of a frame.
